name: screencast-skills
description: Author and produce narrated screencast tutorials for AI tooling and any developer workflow. screencast-storyboard scripts a tutorial: it reads the real docs and drafts an approved storyboard (transcript + timeline). screencast-tutorial-video produces the video: it records each scene with the right engine (VHS terminal, ffmpeg still-motion for native apps, Playwright + cliclick for the browser, command cards) and assembles a voice-over, captioned 1920x1080 MP4. Works in Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and OpenAI Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Script and produce narrated, captioned screencast tutorials for AI tooling on macOS
